name: Scout Orb
description: A basic capture orb for early wild BitPals. Best through the first routes.

name: Adept Orb
description: A stronger capture orb tuned for mid-route BitPals around Lv.15 and above.

name: Prime Orb
description: A high-grade capture orb for tougher late-route and rare BitPals.

name: Apex Orb
description: An endgame capture orb designed for rare BitPals in Apex-locked areas.

name: Potion
description: Restores 20 HP to your active monster.

name: Super Potion
description: Restores 50 HP to your active monster.

name: Hyper Potion
description: Restores 120 HP to your active monster.

name: Mega Potion
description: Restores 200 HP to your active monster.

name: Grove Stone
description: A mossy catalyst used to evolve certain Grass-aligned BitPals.

name: Volt Module
description: A charged core used to trigger certain Electric evolutions.

name: Terra Core
description: A dense mineral heart used to evolve certain Rock BitPals.
